reviews.text: Exceptional service with decent prices . Thank you, Dr Farid!
They are extraordinary
Really grateful for this vet. It's super close to my home, and they're always there for me by phone, email, or in person when my sweet cat needs care.
I really love this clinic; the staff are all super nice. I know I'm paying for my animals' care, not for the renovations, lol. A big thank you for everything!
Emergency appointment made the same day, very competent, kind, beautiful spacious room.

I discovered this veterinary hospital because Kitana suddenly became ill last Thursday, and I had to seek immediate medical attention. It was a blessing in disguise. Kitana was quickly seen and treated by Dr. Gendron. She is now fully recovered and looking brand new again! Thank you for the excellent service we received throughout our visit, and we will definitely be back, hopefully under better circumstances. The place is spotless, the staff is incredibly courteous and welcoming, and it's located in a charming little corner of Montreal. Thank you so much for everything, and we look forward to seeing you again!
Excellent service

My dog, a French bulldog, was having a lot of trouble breathing. I had gotten a quote from another vet, and a friend recommended I get a second opinion. I contacted the clinic, they saw my dog ​​Léa very quickly, and they took her in. They considered the surgery urgent (which I agreed with), and they made room for us very quickly. Now, my dog ​​has recovered from the surgery and is doing great. I would recommend this clinic and the vet, Farid Habib.
Great service! My Cookie is always well taken care of. They are very professional and they always call to remind us of important dates like vaccination, appointments, etc.

Exceptional service for the hospitalization and follow-up of my 6-year-old male cat who had a urinary tract infection affecting his kidneys. The veterinarians truly listen to both the animals and their owners! They are transparent about costs and provide outstanding customer service.

I was referred to Dr. Farid as a last resort & he worked a miracle! My dog had a massive tumour growing in his elbow which made it super complicated. Before Dr.Farid my options were to leave it or amputate. It’s been 2 weeks and my husky is running around as if nothing had happened! Super grateful for the team at Petit Laurier

I have nothing but positive things to say about the Petit Laurier Veterinary Hospital. The veterinarians, technicians, and all the staff are warm, empathetic, and above all, available. Furthermore, it's an independent clinic, proudly Quebec/Canadian, that provides outstanding service and gives us honest advice about our pets, who are part of the family.

Thank you.

My cat received excellent care at the clinic; they were seen quickly, had appropriate tests, the diagnosis explained clearly, and provided compassionate support. My cat is recovering well. Thank you to the entire team and to Dr. Habib.

I cannot thank the entire team at Petit Laurier Animal Hospital enough for saving my cat, Maples. She was hit by a car and arrived with life-threatening injuries that required two complicated surgeries on her intestines and diaphram. Their skill, professionalism, and compassion were evident every step of the way. They took the time to explain everything, answer my questions, and treated Maples with such kindness and dedication. I will always be grateful for everything they did. If you're ever faced with an emergency or need exceptional veterinary care, I recommend Petit Laurier Animal Hospital without hesitation. !!!
Thank you to the hole team :)

The professional service is excellent.

When our pet isn't well, we get stressed and worried, and here we feel listened to, reassured, and supported. They take the time to explain things instead of making us feel like just another case.

I want to highlight Dr. Habib and his partner, Dr. Bole, who are truly exemplary. They have a dedicated and caring team of doctors, technicians, and administrative staff. They treat each animal as if it were their own, with genuine tenderness. 😍

One thing that strikes you when you go: it's always full. There are tons of patients, the waiting room is constantly busy. And honestly, that says a lot. A clinic this busy that still manages to give so much attention and care to each animal is rare. You can tell they're popular for good reason, and despite the high volume of patients, you never feel rushed or neglected.

This is the first time my dog ​​has felt so comfortable at the vet's. He's usually nervous in these kinds of places, but now he's happy to go. For me, that says it all. An animal doesn't fake it: if they trust you, it's because you've made them trust you. ❤️🐕

In short, I recommend this clinic without hesitation. If you're looking for a competent, honest team that truly cares about your pet's well-being, this is the place to go. 🐕🐈

Thank you for everything you do; it's clear this is more than just a job for you. 🫶❤️🌞

An exceptional, compassionate, and deeply dedicated team

We went through an extremely stressful situation with our young cat, Merlin, who had ingested foreign objects requiring urgent surgery. We were fortunate to be treated by Dr. Farid Habib, who was absolutely incredible from beginning to end.

Dr. Habib was honest, transparent, attentive, and extremely accommodating. Despite our difficult financial situation and immense worry, he took the time to explain the different options to us and truly worked with us to find the best solution for Merlin.

But what particularly impressed us was the compassion and dedication of the entire team. We have rarely encountered a veterinary team so caring, dedicated, and concerned about the well-being of both the animal and its owners. We always felt that Merlin was in good hands.

Today, thanks to them, Merlin is alive and back home with us. They literally saved his life, and we will be eternally grateful.

A huge thank you to Dr. Farid Habib and his entire team for their professionalism, compassion, and everything they did for our little Merlin. ❤️

We wholeheartedly recommend this team. 🐾
Truly a superb clinic. The welcome, the treatment of the animal, the support, the follow-up, the kindness. Thank you for that.

I truly enjoyed my experience here. From the reception staff to the veterinary assistants and the veterinarian herself, everyone was kind, caring, patient, and so much more. I came several times in a short period because my cat was sick, and each time they took the time to explain all the steps to follow to care for him. Whenever I had questions, someone was always available by phone. I have absolutely nothing negative to say; thank you so much to the whole team! :)

A huge thank you to the entire team at Petit Laurier for taking such good care of my Katman. Thursday morning, he was vomiting repeatedly: Dr. Gendron saw us as an emergency, immediately thought of an ultrasound, and identified the problem. Then, Dr. Habib took over and operated on him within hours: he saved his life.

The next day, Katman went home and is recovering well. I am so grateful, thank you from the bottom of my heart to all the staff, but especially to Drs. Gendron and Habib.

Beautiful clinic, warm and personalized welcome.
We didn't feel pressured to buy services or products other than those we needed.
The prices are good!
We're happy we chose this clinic.
Fantastic visit, the best in 6 years with my dog! The people who work here are very caring and attentive to the animals. Thank you for your work.

A HUGE THANK YOU to the entire team at Le Petit Laurier Veterinary Clinic, with a special thank you to Dr. Farid Habib, Dr. Léonie Poupart, and Antonia, Julie, Maude, and Maxime.

An extraordinary team that saved the life of our little Lola, who was suffering from pyometra. While we were desperately searching for a clinic to perform emergency surgery on our little Pom, and all the clinics we contacted told us they had no availability for 2-3 weeks (for a situation requiring immediate surgical intervention, otherwise it's fatal), the team at Le Petit Laurier performed the surgery the very next day after our call.

And what can I say about the post-surgery care? Our little Lola put us through the wringer, and we were constantly worried, but every time we contacted a team member by email, we received a response within the hour.

Truly a clinic I recommend without hesitation. A team that listens with empathy and understanding, who will reassure you. Well done to you all and THANK YOU again for saving our little Cocotte's life.

My only disappointment in this whole experience: not being able to give you more than 5 stars.
Super nice. 👌 …

A huge thank you to the veterinarian and the entire team who took care of our husky, Raya, in an emergency today.

Despite an already busy day and a very demanding schedule, you did everything possible to operate quickly and remove the foreign object blocking her intestine. Your professionalism, dedication, compassion, and responsiveness made all the difference.

We are incredibly grateful that you did everything you could to save our Raya. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts for the excellent care you provided and for the support you offered us during this difficult time.

You do exceptional work, and we can't thank you enough.

An update on Napoleon (Napo to his friends): the abscess on his right side has drained and closed after four months of antibiotics. The one on his left side closed three days ago. He'll finish the antibiotics and probiotics tonight. If it recurs, we'll have it drained... A huge THANK YOU to you all!

I would like to thank the entire team for their dedication. They took care of our beautiful Kyra until her very last moments recently, and yesterday I received a lovely card in the mail containing her paw print as well as a lock of her fur and whiskers. What a thoughtful gesture! Thank you again 🙏 …

Our appointment was perfect! Dr. Habib was gentle, clear, attentive, and above all, very responsive to the needs of our family and our beloved dog. We had had difficult experiences with other veterinarians in Montreal in the past, so we were a little apprehensive about having to seek emergency care. Fortunately, by calling the Petit Laurier clinic, we truly found THE right clinic for our dogs. All the steps were explained to us in detail, and the tests were chosen based on our dog's needs and our family values. Tonight, Elvis is already feeling better, and I am relieved to be able to trust his new veterinarian going forward.
Truly the best place! They saved my cats life and showed so much care and sympathy. Could not recommend them more!
Excellent clinic with friendly and welcoming service

My dog underwent major knee surgery that required a lot of post operation care for three months and they were VERY attentive and caring.

I've had bad experiences with previous vets and these guys are by far the best!

Thanks for giving Joon soo much love. Much appreciated!

I had to go there urgently in the evening for my cat who had developed urinary crystals. The staff was fantastic, attentive, and incredibly respectful of our animals; you can tell they truly care about their well-being. My cat is "spicy"; at her previous vet, she had to be sedated for certain tests, but that wasn't necessary here :) The price is also very competitive.

We brought our sick.dog to Dr. Habib and each time we went there we had tests taken with the assurance that he would call the next day to give us the results. One time it took10 days and another time eight days to get results. If we did not call after so many days he would probably never had called back with the results.
Each time he apologized but never made it a point to call as promised.
We are done paying out approximately 2,500.00 and have found an absolutely wonderful vet called Little Italy Pet Hospital on St. Laurent. They are new and are not over booking where they cannot keep a promise.

The veterinarians here are dedicated and give 100% every day to provide the best care for the animals. They have state-of-the-art equipment and perform a wide range of surgeries in addition to handling emergencies!
I received excellent service at this clinic. I was able to quickly get a last-minute appointment for an emergency, and Dr. Habib was professional, diligent, and attentive! I am very satisfied.

Having a sick pet is a daunting experience full of unknowns. It's impossible to truly know what to do or how they feel.

The only certainty is that they depend on us, and having a veterinarian who understands this is essential. Our 10-month-old cat had an accident and broke his left radius. The Petit Laurier Hospital treated us as an emergency and cared for the youngest member of our family as if he were one of their own. Absolutely incredible service provided by a compassionate and highly competent staff.

10 out of 5 stars.
The best veterinary clinic in town.

I've been to several veterinary clinics, and Le Petit Laurier is definitely my favorite! My partner and I have a cat, Chibi, and we discovered this clinic about a year ago. We're extremely satisfied! Booking appointments is quick and easy, they send reminders for due vaccinations and schedule appointments via text and email, the staff is always very kind and professional, there's practically never a wait, it's very clean, and there are often a few animals roaming freely in the clinic (probably the employees' dogs or cats); it really makes the clinic feel warm and welcoming! Our veterinarian, Dr. Camille Calvé, is amazing. She listens very carefully to our questions and is non-judgmental, always gives excellent advice, and takes care of our cat gently. You can feel her love for animals. Thank you so much for everything, Dr. Calvé! 🥰

A few months ago, during an emergency, we called for advice, and they told us to come in. They saw our cat between appointments, and everything was sorted out that same morning!

In short, are you looking for a good vet? Let me tell you, you can stop your search; you won't find better than Le Petit Laurier!! 🐈‍⬛🐕

Thank you to the Petit Laurier Veterinary Hospital for taking such good care of Kichta (and me, haha)!
Receptionists, veterinary nurses, veterinarians—the staff provides top-quality service; they are patient, courteous, and understanding. I'm making it my new go-to clinic for my furry friends.
Special mention to Dr. Calvé for her professionalism, expertise, and compassion!

Incredibly caring, transparent, and kind. They took care of my dog when we walked in after he’d been attacked. Made a nervous puppy feel calm and safe. I’d recommend them to anyone looking to get the best care

Unbelievable Dr. Habib. Went above and beyond duty and care. Opened earlier on Saturday and performed intestinal surgery on my cat, Emmy.
Wonderful staff.
I can’t recommend this « country-type » clinic enough. Reminds me of my youth on the farm with the country vets.
Wonderful!!!!
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
Finally, a veterinarian where the service is warm and humane and the prices are reasonable.
Best service ever, compassion staff, extremely transparent and not pushy. Would recommend 100% !!
Very satisfied, all the staff were courteous and took good care of the animals.
Good atmosphere, friendly staff
Clean environment, the staffs are kind, welcoming, and patient, and the cost is very reasonable. Thank you to Dr. Nicolas for seeing us and providing a pleasant experience!
Great team and everyone there is so patient - highly recommend!

This is the best vet in town! I went there before for my friend's cat and I loved Dr. Habib, so I didn't hesitate for a second when I had to get our little rescue cat, Skylar, checked out! He proved to me once again that I made the right choice of clinic! All the staff are clearly very caring, and it shows because they were deeply touched by our story and helped us tremendously! Thank you for everything!
I 100% recommend them! The people are super friendly, the service is really excellent, and our cats were treated with care and gentleness. Thank you for taking such good care of our babies :)

As a first-time puppy owner, and especially with a tiny teacup-sized puppy, I was extremely careful about choosing the right clinic. So far, Hôpital Vétérinaire Le Petit Laurier has been a wonderful experience for me and my puppy, Rina.

A special thank you to Dr. Anaïs De Campos for Rina’s vaccine visit and early care, and to Dr. Habib for her spay surgery. Both experiences made me feel that Rina was in very good hands. Dr. Habib did an excellent job with her surgery, and I was very happy with how smoothly everything went and how well she healed afterward.

Rina is very small and sensitive, so comfort and gentle handling matter a lot to me. What I really appreciated is that everyone at the clinic has been kind, calm, and welcoming every time I’ve been there. Even the rest of the team, whose names I do not know, have all been lovely with her.

I also really appreciated the follow-up and how responsive and caring they were. That meant a lot to me.

I feel very comfortable continuing Rina’s care with this clinic, and I would absolutely recommend them to anyone looking for a kind, professional, and trustworthy team for both routine puppy care and spay surgery.

A huge thank you for the support and kindness we received during our visit. Finding a veterinarian with such a caring and reassuring team makes all the difference in an emergency. Their calm, availability, and attentiveness helped me immensely through this difficult time. My little Milky was treated with the utmost gentleness and care by the entire team. A trustworthy place that I highly recommend!

The real pros are at the Petit Laurier Hospital ♥️. They welcome us and our little one, listen to us with great care, suggest the appropriate tests, and provide accurate treatment, medication, and home follow-up ♥️.
A great, thoughtful team
Growing confidence
Thank you!
Very compassionate and professional staff.
The most transparent and humane veterinarian in Montreal
Excellent service, fast, efficient and friendly!

I'm taking a moment to write this message because some experiences deserve to be recognized for their true worth.

A huge thank you to the entire team at Le Petit Laurier Veterinary Hospital.

From the first contact to the follow-up after treatment, we received absolutely remarkable care. Their professionalism is undeniable, but what truly sets them apart is their humanity. You quickly realize that you're not just a file or an appointment in the schedule: they take the time, they listen, they explain, and above all… they reassure you.

At a time when worry was overwhelming, their vigilance and expertise literally made all the difference. Thanks to them, our dog is alive today, and that is priceless. Their ability to quickly identify the problem, to act precisely, and then to provide consistent follow-up gave us complete confidence.

But beyond the care itself, it's the incredible attention given to the people behind the animal that truly deserves to be highlighted. We felt supported from beginning to end. They checked in on us, made sure we understood each step, and gave us access to resources whenever we needed them.

It's rare to encounter such competent teams, but even rarer to find ones that combine so much heart with their expertise.

If I could give more than 5 stars, I would without hesitation. Unfortunately, Google doesn't allow it… but please know that you more than deserve them.

Thank you again for everything. You've made a huge difference in our lives.

Superb vet: they were able to diagnose Zazou's problem after another vet made a mistake. She's now on the right treatment and is already doing better. The whole team was extremely professional and, above all, compassionate during our visit.
Courteous, attentive, and professional staff. Quiet, clean, and well-equipped location...

Dr. Habib and his team literally saved our Jackson in an emergency after other vets refused to treat him. Their prices are fair, and the follow-up care is impeccable. The whole team is empathetic, caring, and wonderful!

1 star
"Bad, aggressive service and a total lack of transparency"
"I called today, April 22nd at 1:04 PM exactly, for an estimate and consultation for a dental cleaning. I was prepared to pay the $105 consultation fee, but I had legitimate questions about the breakdown of the costs (which start at $1500 without extractions!). I wanted to know if polishing was included, as I'm looking for a detailed service.
The receptionist refused to send me anything in writing. As soon as I mentioned it was more expensive than elsewhere, she became rude and aggressive. She snapped at me and hung up without saying anything else. This is unusually impolite for a clinic with a 4.9 rating.
For comparison, at the Griffintown Veterinary Clinic, they immediately printed out the complete breakdown with transparency and courtesy." Here, you're treated with contempt as soon as you ask questions. A total lack of respect. Go elsewhere.
Very cute place and bigger than expected. Very kind and attentive staff 🥰 …

I brought my cat in for an emergency appointment, and it turned out she had cardiac issues. Dr. Habib was incredibly kind and compassionate from the moment we arrived. He not only took excellent care of my cat, but also reassured and encouraged me during a very stressful time. He was able to identify the issue right away, and we started treatment quickly.

Dr. Habib was very understanding of our situation and did everything he could to provide the best possible care while being mindful of my budget. I also appreciated that he personally called afterward to follow up and check on how my cat, Akira, was doing.

I will now be a regular with them and highly recommend Dr. Habib and his team for their professionalism, kindness, and genuine care.

Le Petit Laurier took us in the same day, following an emergency that another veterinary clinic had underestimated. I received close follow-up care; I felt the team cared about my cat's well-being as much as I did, and that we were well looked after.

I'm truly reassured to know this clinic exists, as well as Dr. Gendron, for my big, aging cat.
A truly wonderful experience. The staff are incredibly competent, kind, and attentive. The prices are reasonable, and you can tell they're there for the right reasons. We'll definitely be back!

I have nothing but positive things to say about this hospital!

All the staff are extraordinary and, above all, so compassionate.
The clinic was referred to me by the DVM because I needed emergency surgery for my dog, and Dr. Habib agreed to see her at the last minute, even though it was already the end of the day.

He was very reassuring, and his explanations were easy to understand despite the panic I was experiencing.

Furthermore, he and his team provided comprehensive follow-up care from the moment she came out of surgery until her discharge.
They were able to answer my questions and, most importantly, address my concerns whenever I needed them.

The surgery went very well, and she recovered completely.
They are animal lovers, and it shows.
Although I come from the southwest shore, I would make the trip again without hesitation if necessary!

A huge thank you to the entire team; you saved the most precious being in my life 🙏

This vet is just perfect, very humane service, explains everything clearly about your pet, and has a wonderful approach with your companion.

They don't overcharge, quite the opposite, if they can help you out, they do. 5/5 service! 🙌🏽 They saved our little Pancho on a public holiday in an emergency, and the follow-up was perfect from beginning to end! Thank you for everything and to the whole team 💯 Signed: Pancho the Chop 🥩

A wonderful veterinary clinic. The team is professional and very empathetic. They are truly dedicated to providing the best care, comfort, and quality of life for our pets. They are also very honest about the treatments and options available. They provided excellent service for our senior cat. We are grateful for their kindness and attentiveness at every step.

Today, I had a very poor experience with the reception staff. I understand that the person at reception may have had a stressful day; however, from the very beginning, when I inquired about food for my dog, her attitude was already somewhat defensive.

Later, she was unavailable, which can happen and is understandable. However, what was most disturbing was that when I tried to calmly express my feelings about the quality of service, she became even more defensive. This reaction made the interaction particularly unpleasant.

I found this attitude frankly shocking and unprofessional. For this reason, I no longer wish to use the veterinary services or shop at this establishment.

By far the best veterinary hospital we've ever been to.

The entire team is exceptional: compassionate, competent, and deeply caring. The veterinarians take the time to explain their reasoning clearly and transparently, allowing us to truly understand the situation and feel confident every step of the way. They examine our dog thoroughly, without ever rushing, and always answer all our questions, whether in person or even over the phone.

The clinic is beautiful, perfectly organized, and appointments are always on time. They also demonstrate great flexibility in emergencies and greatly simplify management by centralizing treatments and recommended products in one place.

And despite this exceptional level of service, the prices remain quite reasonable and comparable to the rest of the market.

Honestly, I couldn't be more grateful. I recommend them without hesitation.

My usual veterinary clinic couldn't see my kitten as an emergency. They referred me to this clinic, which managed to find an appointment quickly, even on the same day. The reception staff are very friendly. The vet who saw my kitten explained the possible diagnoses. My kitten then had an abdominal ultrasound at the clinic. Everything was explained clearly. Excellent service.

My dog ​​Mirah and I have finally found the clinic I've been searching for for six years! I had lost all confidence, exasperated by what others tried to sell me and the tests they wanted me to undergo. So I was looking for an independent clinic, not run by multinational corporations more interested in profit than anything else.
At Clinique Le Petit Laurier, we received a very warm welcome. All the staff listened attentively. Dr. Bolle explained things that concerned me without pressuring me to buy anything. But the one who was most won over was Mirah, who allowed herself to be examined so docilely by Dr. Bolle, who gave her all the time she needed to get used to it.
I am truly grateful for the services and attention I received. Thank you to the entire team.

Hello, thank you so much for having us with my lovely Betty 😊 The team is very welcoming and always offers great advice! Following the excellent service with my lovely Naya, who left last year, we're back!!! It's a pleasure to see you again 😊❤️ I highly recommend it 🐕🐾 …
Excellent, personalized, and fast service. Good price too.
We were very well received, our cat was very well cared for.

Came here for a second opinion for my cats ear infection and finally they figured out right away what was wrong with her ears. 3 weeks later and her ears are still clear after months suffering, it took me to just get a second opinion. The previous vet I was going to I took her at least 4 times and they couldn't figure out what was wrong with her ears. Im so releived thank you.
The staff are super nice!
Exceptional customer service. The care is excellent. My cat approves.

We recently switched veterinary clinics for Mogli to get a second opinion on her health. We were greeted with great kindness and gentleness by Dr. Calvé.

For the first time, Mogli was examined on the floor rather than on the table, which usually frightens her greatly. The vet let her come to her, at her own pace.

I was also pleasantly surprised to see how much the animal's well-being is at the heart of their approach. Care is prioritized, and their prices are below market rates, which I found very honest in an industry where it's sometimes easy to get lost.

Thank you for the care. 🤍
